Why the BAAJA Permitting Reform Bill Is Dividing Climate and Energy Advocates

The Senate voted on Nov. 18 to move forward with the Bipartisan Affordability and American Jobs Act (BAAJA) of 2026, a controversial permitting reform bill that aims to speed up the nation’s ability to build infrastructure and energy —which can often take years under the current process.
